steps.what: Sort library mail and packages and deliver them to recipients

tasks.design: Retain physical sorting and delivery by the technician. An existing recipient directory in {DOCS} can answer location questions without creating a new tracking workflow.
tasks.previous_blocker: Mail and packages must be physically moved.
tasks.enabler_now: Digital directories can support exceptions but do not perform delivery.
tasks.still_hard: Unclear addressees and items needing careful handling.
tasks.human_edge: The technician resolves ambiguous destinations and protects the items.
tasks.altitude: No change to the technician's week or decision rights.

evidence.claim: Software does not replace the physical handling and movement of library packages in this boundary.

assumptions: Boundary is physical sorting and delivery, excluding acquisitions recording and invoice processing.
The technician reads existing sender-produced delivery labels during the full-time step; no structured address feed or free scanning step is assumed.
Use existing recipient information before considering software changes.
Zero incremental upkeep because no tracking service or changed capture process is introduced.
research_questions: Is any observed mail-handling time actually duplicate record entry rather than physical work?

already_counted.description: Physical sorting and delivery including location exceptions

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; net 0. No changed physical operation or invented administrative baseline.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Select sources for bibliographies on the group's subject of interest
Prepare abstracts and compile the bibliography draft

loop.purpose: Draft short source-faithful abstracts for selected materials
loop.input: Selected texts, verified citation metadata and subject brief
loop.output: Abstracts with source passages and a formatted bibliography draft
loop.check: Technician checks each abstract against the source for purpose, findings, limitations and relevance; code checks citation identifiers resolve and required metadata is present
loop.stop: One correction pass then manual abstract writing if source support is incomplete
loop.why_not_simpler: Citation formatting is deterministic, but summarising a source's meaning for a particular audience needs bounded language interpretation

steps.what: Review the bibliography and abstracts before release to the group

tasks.design: Export selected citation records from {OTHER}, the library discovery system, and draft abstracts only from accessible source text. Format citations with native tools in {DOCS}; the technician checks meaning and releases the final version.
tasks.previous_blocker: Citations are assembled separately from source summaries.
tasks.enabler_now: Source-linked answer drafting exists, and native citation formatting can reduce mechanical assembly.
tasks.still_hard: Selecting representative sources and avoiding overstatement in short abstracts.
tasks.human_edge: The technician understands the group's purpose and recognises missing or misleading coverage.
tasks.altitude: Less first-draft composition while source selection and release remain explicit work.

reach.learn: Search coverage and critical source evaluation

evidence.claim: Primo Research Assistant generates reference answers from five abstracts with source links. This supports source-linked drafting capability, not validated full-text abstracts or complete bibliographies.
The selected-text abstract workflow and its labour estimate are E1 design assumptions requiring a source-checking pilot.

assumptions: Boundary begins with the group's request and ends with bibliography release, excluding separate reference conversations or acquisition work.

Technician produces the subject brief and selected source set in s1: topic, audience, date range, record identifiers, title, author, year, edition, source link and text excerpts. Its full 35 hours include export, missing metadata correction and any text capture.

Existing catalogue metadata comes from cataloguers' ordinary work; no new enrichment is assigned free. Inaccessible sources are excluded with explanation or handled manually, never summarised from a title alone.
Test native citation export and document templates first. Five focal upkeep hours cover draft failures and citation tests; two librarian hours cover source-policy review per 100 focal baseline hours.
unknowns: Actual source selection and abstracting time
research_questions: Does abstract drafting save time after source capture, claim verification and manual fallback?

already_counted.description: Check abstract meaning and correct drafts

incremental.description: Review failures and citation export tests

approvals.approved_version: Exact bibliography version, citation records, abstract text and source links; content changes require renewed approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=35+22.5+20=77.5; gross 22.5 minus 5 focal upkeep gives net 17.5. Low 5 allows 12.5 extra hours of source capture and manual abstract correction; E1 scenarios.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Keep physical mail work unchanged and reduce only checked bibliography drafting.
reach: Help librarians prepare source-based reading guides
role.ambitious_version: A technician producing reliable reading material with visible source support.
